data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 11.701m. Based on the gross claims development table the syndicate recorded a net favourable prior-year reserve movement of approximately GBP 1.56m (a release, ~13.4% of opening reserves), driven by favourable development in older underwriting years (notably the 2011 year). The 2018 year was materially affected by the receipt of a reinsurance-to-close (RITC) from syndicate 3334 which increased gross reserves by GBP 37.65m; this RITC distorts simple comparisons and the reconciliation table. Data are taken from the gross claims development triangle and the technical provisions reconciliation.
raw_causal_phrases: During the year the syndicate accepted the reinsurance to close (RITC) for syndicate 3334, as detailed on page 4.
The most critical assumption as regards claims provisions is that the past is a reasonable predictor of the likely level of claims development.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross figure is not explicitly labelled as 'movement in prior years' in the notes. No separate 'movement in prior year's provision' gross line was found. PYD was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (comparison of 2011 current estimate vs prior diagonal) resulting in a GBP 1.564m release. The syndicate accepted a large RITC from syndicate 3334 (gross GBP 37.65m) during 2018 which materially distorts reserve movement comparisons and the reconciliation; the triangle has limited UW year columns (2011, 2012, 2018) which limits the PYD calculation. Where line-of-business reserve movements were not separately disclosed, lob_movements is left empty. Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, prior-year column).
